title: Portability: stamp import event domain schema
description: Objective: close the producer-side schema omission blocking the strict daemon shadow reader. Deliverable: every event emitted by public applyImport declares the exact moe-import-event-facts/1 domainSchemaVersion at the StoredEvent envelope as well as inside its canonical payload, with real-SQLite replay evidence. NOT in scope: daemon shadow mapping, importer semantics, event ids/payload bytes, activation, cutover, or new wire kinds. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/import typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/import test && pnpm test:migration && pnpm test:store.
definitionOfDone: ImportEventDraft requires domainSchemaVersion typed to typeof IMPORT_EVENT_FACTS_VERSION, and every production applyImport event sets it to moe-import-event-facts/1 without changing the existing event id, event type, canonical payload, or command identity.

A real SqliteEventStore integration test asserts a positive stored-event count and, for every event, exact equality among StoredEvent.domainSchemaVersion, decoded facts.schemaVersion, and IMPORT_EVENT_FACTS_VERSION; it also pins eventId === decoded claim.claimId and aggregateId === legacy-import:<manifestDigest>.
Replaying identical source bytes preserves event ids, payload bytes, domain schema, raw event count, and raw command-decision count, with no second commit or partial residue.

A production-stamp mutation (remove or change the domainSchemaVersion assignment) reddens the named real-store assertion, and all refusal checks assert exact stable import/store code and layer rather than only failure.
Fresh @moe/import typecheck/test, migration, and store gates execute with nonzero test-count lines where applicable; task-80fce1d1d625453098bd526d61c5ddb8 is recorded as the reader consumer.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1) Accept the store's generic `moe-domain-schema/0` default and trust only the inner JSON schema. Rejected: it makes the future strict reader ignore a first-class event-envelope field and bakes the producer omission into the contract.

2) Add a second import-specific schema constant in daemon or store. Rejected: `IMPORT_EVENT_FACTS_VERSION` already is the exact public single source and both envelope/payload must agree.

3) Change the canonical payload, event id, or command identity to include the stamp. Rejected: the payload already declares the version; @moe/store deliberately excludes domainSchemaVersion from request/effect identity so upcasters can change it without invalidating receipts. This task changes envelope metadata only.

4) Backfill/restamp pre-fix stored rows on replay. Rejected as out of scope and impossible through plain idempotent replay: the store intentionally ignores domainSchemaVersion in identity and returns the original row. No production importer call site has shipped such rows; if historical remediation becomes required, it needs an explicit migration/upcast task, not a hidden rewrite here.

5) Prove only the captured draft in a spy. Rejected: the defect is the real StoredEvent default, so the accepted control must traverse production applyImport and real SqliteEventStore.

6) Compare two post-change runs and call identity preserved. Rejected as tautological; the unit test pins pre-change golden command/event identities measured before editing.
